# Atlantic City: Civil Engineer Body Armour Guide

__Civil Engineer Armour__

The Set Bonus for Civil Engineering Armour:

- 10% chance of 150 Fire Damage to Melee Attackers (equivalent to 10 fire damage per second for 15 seconds)

This can not be stacked for higher damage (ie 20% chance for 300 Fire Damage). You can only have one Fire Damage attack active on each enemy at any given time.

The 10% chance of 150 Fire Damage does not work against other players, so will have no effect if equipped during PVP.

- Weapons break 35% slower

Gunsmith perk card under Intelligence stacks with the Weapons break 35% slower bonus.

The helmet does not count towards the set bonus.
